title: Settings
summary: Compact settings: a few settings a person changes on the spot, as data, each holding its own value, drawn by sf-menu-context in one of two looks -- drill (the value under the name, the options in the same panel) or rows (the control at the row's end; a choice that does not fit beside its name drills by itself). With a trigger it opens over the page (a bottom sheet on a phone); without one it stands in the page's flow. A change is asked first (cancellable), then written and reported; remember keeps the values for the person. Where a product has a sign-in, the person's theme, language and text size are rows of the person menu (sf-menu-context, owner decision C176 (1)); sf-settings is the gear of a screen's view and of a site without a sign-in. The panel look (C106) draws a panel of its own for a list's view settings: sections or tabs, fields lists with a check, a handle, a pin and a search, applied at once or by «Применить».

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

look.description: The arrangement. drill: the current value under the name and a chevron, the options open in the same panel with a way back. rows: the name at the start, the control at the end -- quiet options, a switch, a slider; a choice whose options do not fit beside its name becomes a drill row by itself, the value under the name and the options a level deeper (owner decision C176 (3)). panel (owner decision C106): a list's view settings in a panel of its own -- the groups as sections in one scroll, or as tabs when the panel has a search and a group holds a fields list; a checked field is the theme's light fill with a check at the inline end, a choice of one the fill alone; a dialog over the page, a bottom sheet on a phone. tiles is a former name of drill until 2027-01-01 (C176 (5)): its switches are rows, and a page that asks for deprecation notes hears it once. The menu looks are a bottom sheet on a phone (C157 (5))

apply.description: How the panel look applies a change (C106 (4)). instant: at once, as every look -- change, then changed; the footer holds one «Сбросить» (the declared values back). button: a filter's -- the changes wait in the panel until «Применить (N)» (N: the checked fields and the switches on), then go out as change and changed and the popup closes; «Сбросить» puts the declared values into the panel, and closing drops what was not applied. The other looks apply at once

search.description: A search over the panel look's rows (C106 (7), C30 R071: a setting, never by the number of rows; the docs advise it from ten rows): a header over the body; the rows are filtered as the field is typed in -- no case, ё as е, on a row's text, caption and keywords. With it, a group that holds a fields list makes the groups tabs. Down from the field enters the rows

size.description: The menu's rung: rows of 40 px at 1 (the default, owner decision C22: a site and the docs are the ordinary size; compactness is the region's density, data-sf-density="compact"), of 32 px at 1/2. A value row (the value under the name) grows by its line

for.description: The id of a page element, or several separated by spaces, that opens the panel when pressed; the trigger slot is the other way. With neither the panel stands open in the page's flow

remember.description: A name to keep the values under: they are a preference of the person (SF.Preferences key sf-settings/<name>; in the browser localStorage sf-pref:sf-settings/<name>, and a host that keeps preferences for its user gets them), written after every change and put back into the items before the first drawing

label.description: The panel's accessible name. «Настройки» / «Settings» in the page language when not set

apply-count.description: The number «Применить (N)» shows in a panel applied by the button, when the page counts it (a filter whose conditions are not rows of this panel); a whole number from 0. Not set, the panel counts: the checked fields and the switches on

close-label.description: The popup panel's close button's name; «Закрыть» / «Close» in the page language when not set

search-placeholder.description: The words in the panel's search field, and its name; «Найти» / «Find» in the page language when not set

empty-text.description: What the panel says when the search finds no row; «Ничего не найдено» / «Nothing found» in the page language when not set

pin-label.description: The pin's word on a row that is not pinned: its tooltip, and its name before the row's text («Закрепить: Срок»); «Закрепить» / «Pin» in the page language when not set

unpin-label.description: The pin's word on a pinned row; «Открепить» / «Unpin» in the page language when not set

move-label.description: The description of a list that orders (how to move a row); «Alt со стрелками вверх и вниз меняет порядок» in the page language when not set

items.description: The settings, each holding its own value: {id, type: switch, text, value: true}, {id, type: choice, text, value: <option id>, options: [{id, text, icon?}]}, {id, type: range, text, value, min, max, step, unit}, {id, type: color, text, value: <palette hue name or #rrggbb>, options?: [hue names], custom?: false} (C85: the current colour as the row's circle, a level of hue circles and «Свой цвет…», which opens sf-input-color's window on «Своё»; ten hues by default), {type: heading, text}, {type: separator}, {type: group, text, items}; icon and caption on a setting, disabled on a setting or an option (tile is no longer read: the tiles look left, C176 (5)). A property, or the JSON island a server prints; in the panel look also {id, type: fields, text, options: [{id, text, checked, pinned, disabled}], sortable, pinnable}: a list of many to check (a table's columns), ordered by a handle and Alt+arrows when sortable, pinned on top when pinnable; its value is [{id, checked, pinned}] in order, the pinned first; a choice in the panel look may say sortable and pinnable too (a filter's saved templates, C106 (3), (6)): the chosen option is the fill alone, the handle at the start, the pin at the end, the pinned on top; its value stays the chosen option's id and its order goes out as arrange and arranged ([{id, pinned}]). An option of a list that orders or pins may say sortable: false or pinnable: false (a table's system column): no handle or no pin, their places kept, and it stays where it stands while the others move

setValue.summary: Writes one setting's value into its item: the page's answer to a cancelled change, or a value restored on load. Raises nothing. Refused with not-found when no item carries the id, with invalid when the item cannot hold the value

returns.description: {outcome}: applied; refused with not-found or invalid.

setAll.summary: Writes a map of values -- {id: value} -- into the items that carry those ids: a panel restored from storage in one call. Raises nothing. Refused with not-found when no id of the map is an item's

returns.description: {outcome, count}: how many items were written.

show.summary: Goes straight to one setting: a popup opens against its trigger, the drill look opens the levels down to it, and the focus goes to its row. Refused with not-found when no item carries the id; unavailable with no-trigger for a popup whose trigger is not in the page; cancelled when the menu's open was cancelled

reset.summary: Puts the declared values back -- the values the items carried when the page gave them -- after asking reset; changed goes out once for each setting that moved. A listener that cancels reset keeps the current values

returns.description: {outcome, count}: applied with how many settings moved, or cancelled.

open.summary: The panel look's popup opens against its first trigger, as the trigger's press opens it, on the tab given by its index when the groups are tabs (an open panel turns to that tab). Refused with not-popup for another look or a panel in the page's flow; unavailable with no-trigger when the trigger is not in the page; cancelled when the page cancels open

close.summary: Closes the panel look's open popup as a script (close with reason api, cancellable); what a draft of apply="button" held is dropped. Refused with not-open when it is not open; cancelled when the page cancels close

sf-settings-change.summary: A person asks to change a setting: the request, sent before the value is written. Cancelled, nothing changes and the row keeps the value it had until the page answers with setValue

value.description: The value asked for: a boolean for a switch, a number for a range, the option's id for a choice.

item.description: The item with the value asked for.

sf-settings-changed.summary: The fact: the value is written into its item, the row shows it and remember has kept it. The page applies the setting here. reset raises it once for each setting it moved; setValue and setAll raise nothing

item.description: The item, with its new value.

sf-settings-reset.summary: The declared values are asked back (the reset action): the request. Cancelled, the current values stay

sf-settings-open.summary: A popup panel of look="panel" asks to open (its trigger, show): the request, sent before it is drawn. Cancelled, it stays closed. The other looks open their inner sf-menu-context, which sends its own open

sf-settings-opened.summary: The popup panel of look="panel" is open and drawn

sf-settings-close.summary: The popup panel of look="panel" asks to close: escape, outside (a press outside), close (the close button, the trigger again) or api (Apply, Tab out, a script); unsaved says a draft of apply="button" moved something. Cancelled, it stays open

sf-settings-closed.summary: The popup panel of look="panel" is closed

sf-settings-arrange.summary: A person moves or pins an option of a choice that orders (sortable or pinnable, the panel look; a filter's templates): asked before the order is written. Cancelled, the rows stay as they were. Applied by the button, it goes out on «Применить». A fields list's order is its value: change and changed

order.description: The options' order, the pinned first: [{id, pinned}].

item.description: The item with its new order.

sf-settings-arranged.summary: The fact: the choice's new order is written into its options and the rows show it; remember keeps the values only (the chosen option), not the order

order.description: The options' order, the pinned first: [{id, pinned}].

item.description: The item with its new order.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: applying what a setting means (a dark theme, a dense table): the page listens to changed
saving the values on a server (cancel change, save, answer with setValue)
a menu of actions or a mixed menu (sf-menu-context with its value rows)

keyboard: Tab reaches the panel's one tab stop; the arrows move between rows, Home and End go to the ends
Enter or Space turns a switch, chooses an option or opens a drilling choice; Right goes in, Left and Escape go back
A slider takes the side arrows; Escape on the top level closes a popup and returns focus to the trigger
accessibility.focus: A popup takes the focus on its first row and gives it back to the trigger when it closes; inline the focus stays where the person is.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-settings for a small set of settings a person changes on the spot -- a reader's theme and text size, a table's view, a chat's sound -- opened from a gear or standing in a panel. Where the product has a sign-in, put the person's theme, language and text size as rows of the person menu (sf-menu-context with type choice rows, the language row from SfLanguage.menuEntry) instead (owner decision C176 (1)).
do_not: Do not use sf-settings for a menu of actions or a mixed menu; use sf-menu-context with its value rows
Do not use sf-settings-menu; it was removed and is not an alias
Do not keep a setting's value outside its item; read values or listen to changed
Do not use sf-settings for a long form with validation; use a form
Do not use look="tiles"; it is a former name of drill until 2027-01-01 (C176 (5))
Do not put settings among the actions of a «⋯» menu, and do not write a setting as a submenu of radio rows; a submenu of radio rows is for actions (C176 (2))
Do not set size="1/2" to make it compact; the region's density does that (C22)
